transcript: My friend, most people don't realize this. The way you drink water every day is quietly weakening your body. Long ago, my teacher, Dr. Li Zhongsheng, who lived to 102 years, taught me this. Water can heal you or slowly drain your life energy, depending on how you drink it. Mistake number one, cold water. It feels refreshing, but it shocks the stomach, tightens the blood, and forces your body to struggle. Warm water protects your inner fire, the engine of digestion and vitality. Mistake number two, drinking too fast. When you rush, the body cannot absorb. Sip slowly, like watering a delicate plant. Absorption begins with patience. Mistake number three, drinking during meals. Water dilutes the stomach's fire while food is being transformed. Drink before or after eating, not during, and digestion becomes stronger, not weaker. Mistake number four, skipping water before sleep. One small cup before bed helps cleanse the blood, calm the system, and allows the body to repair itself while you rest. Mistake number five, the wrong amount. Too little dries the body. Too much burdens the kidneys. Health is never excess. It is balance. Remember this, water is life, but only when it is taken with awareness. If this opened your eyes, comment, yes, below. And if you want to go deeper, my e-book is waiting for you. Link in my bio. It was written to help you restore balance, protect your energy, and return the body to its natural rhythm.
